title: RAFT Data Analysis Automation
description: The data analysis portion of my GIS Data and Field Internship involved several manual spreadsheet steps and a data join in QGIS. Once I got the hang of the manual process, I decided to automate the manual steps with Python. Although there is not impetus to integrate automation into this workflow at this time for this internship, I found it to be a useful exercise in applying my software skills to a common data problem.
duties: Technology: Python, pandas, Google API Python Client, and the QGIS CLI
Generates an HTML page so that spreadsheet rows that can easily be copied and pasted into the manual process's output spreadsheet
Github repository with Proof of Concept implementation
